body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If you have 2 or more Combo, the target cannot make Reactions against your movement this turn.

surges.html: If this Action defeats or wounds the target, gain 1 Combo.
Ignore 1 Defense against the primary target for this Action.

rider.title: BLITZ
rider.html: If this Action deals damage, you may spend 1 Combo to move up to 2 units and remain engaged with the target if possible.
